Comedian and jiu-jitsu coach Eddie Bravo shares his take on the new UFO whistleblower in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience. Bravo, Rogan's longtime friend, is famous on the show for embracing the wildest reading of any story. Rogan lets him build the case his way.

Bravo walks through what the whistleblower claimed and why he finds it convincing. Rogan plays the mildly saner friend, asking where the proof sits. The segment is less a briefing than a show of the pair's dynamic: one man chasing the fringe at full speed, the other half a step behind, laughing and listening.
